player_0.content: New plan: I failed the last question because I did not calculate the net displacement. The instructions "Take 6 steps forward," "Take 2 steps backward," and "Take 4 steps backward" result in a net movement of 0 steps (6 - 2 - 4 = 0), meaning I return to the starting point. My mistake was answering "No" without verifying the arithmetic. Next time, I will explicitly calculate the sum of all directional movements (treating forward/right as positive and backward/left as negative) and only answer "Yes" if the final sum is zero.
